beats.label: Who was tracked
beats.text: U.S. adults over **50,** tested on memory and **thinking** for decades.

beats.label: Takeaway 1
beats.text: Each **1-point** rise in BMI was linked to **faster** cognitive decline.

beats.label: Takeaway 2
beats.text: The link peaked around **year 8** and was strongest **after 65.**

beats.label: Takeaway 3
beats.text: The authors call weight one of the most **modifiable** risks for aging well.

beats.label: Possible why
beats.text: Ideas include **inflammation,** blood **flow** and insulin **resistance.** Not proven yet.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: It's a **link,** not proof weight **causes** decline. And BMI alone is a **rough** measure.
Follow for one **brain** study a day, minus the hype.
